system.description: A brood of fellow Nosferatu holds an unceasing vendetta against you. If you stay in the same city, they pool their resources to make your existence a living hell, and travel through the local sewers becomes a nightmare; if you flee, they call in favors in the next city you show your face. This is a specialized variation of the Flaw: Hunted. Consult your Storyteller before taking it, and work with her to determine why you're hunted. She may allow you to buy off this Flaw, but only after you've completed a story in which you've resolved and overcome the vendetta.
system.source: Clanbook: Nosferatu, Chapter Two: Inside Clan Nosferatu
